label: SwissLipids Enrichment
description: For a pathway's metabolites identified by InChIKey, federates to the SwissLipids SPARQL endpoint (beta.sparql.swisslipids.org) to check whether the compound is a registered lipid species, returning its SwissLipids name and equivalent ChEBI class. Matches both lipids proper (fatty acyl-CoAs, phospholipids, ...) and shared cofactors SwissLipids also curates (ATP, CoA, NAD(P)(H), water, diphosphate) because they appear in lipid-metabolism reactions too.
